run_scene_aabb: run the pybullet scene to compute and print the axis-aligned bounding box of all bodies
create_getSceneAABB: create a function that iterates over all bodies and computes the combined scene AABB min and max
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like a plane and sphere into a pybullet simulation
get_body_aabb: get the axis-aligned bounding box for each body in the pybullet simulation using getAABB
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop that steps the physics engine at a fixed time step
